title: Tunisian Crudités
description: A refreshing and crunchy vegetarian crudités dish inspired by Tunisian cuisine, perfect for a light snack or side.
instructions: Cut the carrots, cucumber, and red bell pepper into bite-sized sticks.
Serve the crudités in a bowl with the zesty hummus and crunchy pita chips on the side.
Garnish with fresh parsley and pineapple chunks.
Enjoy as a healthy and refreshing snack!
You can also serve with additional Tunisian olives for extra flavor.
For an added crunch, sprinkle some additional crunchy pita chips on top.
Consider serving with a side of Tunisian flatbread for a more filling snack.
Adjust the amount of zesty hummus to your liking, and enjoy!
This dish is best served immediately, but can be refrigerated for up to 2 hours before serving.
If you have any leftovers, consider serving as a topping for a salad or wrap.
Feel free to customize this recipe to your liking with your favorite vegetables and dips.
